params.name: page[offset]
params.description: The current offset by number of records, not pages. Offset is zero-based. The maximum records you can offset is 10,000. If no page size is set, the [page length](/docs/commerce-cloud/global-project-settings/settings-overview#page-length) store setting is used.

params.name: page[limit]
params.description: The maximum number of records per page for this response. You can set this value up to 100. If no page size is set, the [page length](/docs/commerce-cloud/global-project-settings/settings-overview#page-length) store setting is used.

items.docs:
Retrieves a list of all subscription features.

### Filtering

This endpoint supports filtering. For the general syntax, see [**Filtering**](/guides/Getting-Started/filtering).

| --- | --- | --- | 
| `eq` | `external_ref` | Equals. Checks if the values of two operands are equal. If they are, the condition is true. |
